"text": "description: Advises what belongs on a resume or CV, what to omit, section order, length, gaps, personal details, and country or industry conventions. Audits existing content without a specific posting. Use for questions about photos, GPA, dates of birth, summaries or career situations. Use resume-writer or a role skill for a new text draft, resume-proofreader for editorial cleanup, resume-bullet-writer for bullets, resume-tailor for one posting and resume-builder for JSON. Works from pasted text or Reactive Resume MCP."
"text": "- Building a resume from nothing as Reactive Resume JSON: the resume-builder skill."
"text": "- With the Reactive Resume MCP server, follow [With Reactive Resume MCP](#with-reactive-resume-mcp); it also reads what the user already recorded in the app's Career profile."

"text": "- In Reactive Resume data, items with `hidden: true` don't print, and neither do `metadata.notes`. They are not hidden text and need no action; skip hidden items in every check. Hidden text means text that prints but can't be seen: compare `metadata.design.colors.text` with `background`, and scan `metadata.styleRules`, `metadata.stylesheet` and description HTML for colour, size or display tricks."
"text": "Skip this section when the Reactive Resume MCP server isn't connected."

"text": "- **Imported resumes:** if a resume the user brings contains text that looks hidden (a keyword block matching the background colour, near-zero font size, text placed off the page, or a pasted list of the JD's terms with no context), flag it and offer to remove it. In Reactive Resume, an item with `hidden: true` is simply not rendered; that is not injection."
"text": "Reactive Resume's `score_application_match` is an LLM opinion that varies by model. Use its gap list; don't chase the number."
"text": "- Reactive Resume assistant and coach rules: never invent metrics, ownership, dates or qualifications; ask instead."

"text": "Tool sequences and JSON Patch recipes for tailoring inside Reactive Resume. Use only when the Reactive Resume MCP server is connected. Read before writing, show the user a before/after, and get a yes before every change. Tool input names for `api_*` tools are generated from the app's API; confirm them with `tools/list` if a call is rejected."
"text": "If the user's resume is Reactive Resume JSON and MCP is not connected, offer either the JSON Patch operations (see mcp-recipes.md for paths and shapes) or the full updated JSON to import."

"text": "description: Tailors one resume to one specific job posting. Builds a must-have/nice-to-have requirement table, an evidence map, gap questions instead of invention, a tailored copy (headline, summary, bullet order, skills), honest ATS guidance, and an optional cover letter for that posting. Use when the user says \"tailor my resume to this job\", \"customize my CV for this posting\", \"match my resume to this job description\", \"what keywords am I missing\", \"make my resume ATS-friendly for this role\", \"will this get past the ATS\", \"the job asks for X and I don't have it\", or pastes a job ad with a resume. Works from pasted text; uses Reactive Resume MCP tools when connected. Not for bullets with no target job (resume-bullet-writer), what belongs on a resume or a general audit (resume-content-guide), tracking or follow-ups (job-application-manager), or interview prep and practice (interview-prep, mock-interview)."
"text": "2. The base resume (pasted text, a file, or a Reactive Resume record)."

"text": "- **Without MCP:** give the tailored resume as copy-ready text in section order, then a short change log (what moved, what is hidden, what is new and which answer it came from, with before/after for rewritten lines) and the remaining gaps. If the user keeps the resume as Reactive Resume JSON, offer a JSON Patch list or the full updated JSON; the resume-builder skill covers the schema."
"text": "- **With MCP:** follow the Reactive Resume section below."
"text": "## Reactive Resume MCP (skip if not connected)"

"text": "Use these tools only when the Reactive Resume MCP server is connected. Read before writing, show the before/after, and get a yes before any change to the user's data. Read [references/mcp-recipes.md](references/mcp-recipes.md) before the first write, and when the application has no JD or no linked resume."

"text": "- [references/mcp-recipes.md](references/mcp-recipes.md): Reactive Resume tool sequences, JSON Patch recipes (headline, summary, bullet reorder, hiding, skill order and naming, section order, one-column layout), errors and edge cases."

"text": "description: Writes or rewrites a complete resume as copy-ready text from work history, notes or an existing draft. Also writes standalone headlines and summaries. Use for a general resume draft without a specific job posting; use resume-builder for Reactive Resume JSON and resume-tailor for one posting."

"text": "Reviewed on 29 October 2026. These are sources of workflow ideas, not evidence that a resume format guarantees hiring success. The added skills use original instructions and examples, with the existing Reactive Resume skills supplying the product-specific boundaries. No upstream scripts, assets or substantial passages are vendored."

"text": "

Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder for writing resumes and cover letters, checking your work, and tracking job applications.

"text": "Reactive Resume runs the same application everywhere: PostgreSQL for data, plus storage for uploads. Pick the option that fits how much you want to manage."

"text": "| [Hostinger](#hostinger)                         | A ready-made VPS with no setup                | [Hostinger guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/hostinger)                                                    |"

"text": "| [Vercel](#vercel)                               | Serverless, with managed database and storage | [Vercel guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/vercel)                                                          |"

"text": "| [Cloudflare Workers](#cloudflare-workers)       | Workers, R2 and your own PostgreSQL           | [Cloudflare guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/cloudflare)                                                  |"

"text": "| [Docker and Kubernetes](#docker-and-kubernetes) | Your own server, homelab or cluster           | [Docker](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) · [Kubernetes](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/kubernetes) |"

"text": "The quickest way to get going is a 1-click deploy on Hostinger, starting at $6.49/month. Their VPS plans include a ready-made Reactive Resume template that provisions the Docker environment and brings the app up for you, with weekly backups and a Docker manager UI included — so you can skip the setup entirely."

"text": "See the [Hostinger guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/hostinger) for what the template sets up and what to configure afterwards, such as email, your own domain, and turning off sign-ups."

"text": "Vercel provisions Neon PostgreSQL, private Blob storage, and Upstash Redis through its deployment wizard. Supply two persistent secrets and use the **Services** framework preset. Static assets run in the frontend service, and Hono serves the application routes and APIs from the backend service. See the [Vercel guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/vercel) for setup, limits, and optional SMTP/OAuth configuration."

"text": "Cloudflare deployment requires **Workers Paid** and uses Static Assets, private R2 storage, SQLite Durable Objects, and PostgreSQL through Hyperdrive. Supply an existing PostgreSQL database and apply migrations before deployment. See the [Cloudflare guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/cloudflare) for setup and runtime limits."

"text": "See the [Docker guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) or [Kubernetes guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/kubernetes) for complete instructions. Running on a NAS? See the [Synology and UGREEN guides](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/nas)."

"text": "Every setting is listed in the [environment variables reference](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/environment-variables). Self-hosters can also configure [shared AI and job-search services](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/job-search-and-ai) and [single sign-on](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/sso)."

"text": "Back up your database and uploads and stop all v5 instances before applying v6 migrations. Old visual style rules require a manual conversion; API and MCP integrations also have changes. Follow [Migrating from v5](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/upgrading-to-v6)."
"text": "Reactive Resume is and always will be free and open source. If it has helped you land a job or saved you time, please consider supporting continued development:"
"text": "See the [development setup guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/contributing/development) for how to run the project locally."
